simple.meaning: גָּג (gâg) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a roof ; by analogy, the top of an altar.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 30:3. The surrounding context includes blood, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּג (H1406) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: גָּג (gâg) / H1406 is traced through Exodus 30:3, Exodus 37:26, Deuteronomy 22:8, Joshua 2:6 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H1406. gag גָּג noun masculine roof, top (Late Hebrew id. ; Di compare Ethiopic vinculum (ferreum), jugo simil. collare ferreum ; √ dubious; Thes proposes גגג ; perhaps גנג (= גנגן ) cover Bö § 292 Sta § 189 a MV) — גָּג Josh 2:6 9 t. + 1Sam 9:26 Kt (Qr גָּ֫גָה ), גָּ֫גָה Josh 2:6 ; 1Sam 9:26 Qr (Kt גג ); construct Judg 9:51 2 t. + Ezek 40:13 (strike out Co see below); suffix גַּגֶּךָ֑ Deut 22:8 , גַּגּוֺ Exod 30:3 2 t. + Ezek 40:13 (strike out Co see below); plural גַּגּוֺת Isa 37:27 5 t.; suffix גַּגּוֺתֶיהָ 15:3 , גַּגּוֺתֵיהֶם Jer 32:29 , גַּגֹּתֵיהֶם 19:13 ; — 1 roof (of house) Deut 22:8 ; Josh 2:6 (twice in verse); 2:8 ; Joshua 16:27; 1Sam 9:25-26 , 2Sam 11:2 (twice in verse); 16:22 ; 2Kin 19:26 = Isa 37:27 ; Neh 8:16 ; Psa 102:8 ; 129:6 ; Prov 21:9 ; 25:24 ; Isa 15:3 ; 22:1 ; Jer 48:38 ; as places of idolatrous worship (especially of heavenly bodies) 19:13 ; 32:29 ; Zeph 1:5 ; so אָחָז עֲלִיַּת הַגָּג 2Kin 23:12 , roof of tower Judg 9:51 , 51 , over gate 2Sam 18:24 , of chamber Ezek 40:13 (twice in verse) (but ᵐ5 Co קיר ). 2 top of altar of incense , in tabernacle Exod 30:3 ; 37:26 (both p). גֻּדְגֹּדָה גִּדְּגָּד, גָּד, גַּד, see below גדד .
